messages:
ashley: heads up — got a support ticket from BetaCorp asking for partial streaming + function-call events into their webhook pipeline. ticket #4521. they want early chunks so downstream can start processing.
chris: do they mean partial tokens only or function-call events incrementally?
ashley: both. they need token-level frames and fncall boundaries emitted as they happen (start/chunk/end).
maria: important to scope. current streaming emits token frames; fncall info only at completion. we need to design incremental fncall events + an API contract. @kevin can runtime support emitting function boundaries?
kevin: possible. we can emit events like `fncall_start`, `fncall_chunk`, `fncall_end`. tradeoffs: roughly 5-10% extra CPU on high QPS paths. recommend opt-in per-customer + feature flag rollout. also need clear framing (ndjson) so clients can parse deterministically.
olivia: BetaCorp is on a tight timeline — they want this by EOM next month or they'll pilot with another vendor. they'd pay for Dedicated pilot if we ship opt-in. this could accelerate ARR.
maria: preliminary priority = medium. launch criteria proposal: 1) API spec with event types and examples, 2) contract tests (SDK + server), 3) one customer pilot (BetaCorp), 4) perf baseline within 10% of current median latency, 5) docs + example integrations. any immediate blockers?
chris: blocker: SDKs need new streaming parser helpers for fncall events. devex should add adapter pattern. also need changelog and migration notes.
ashley: support requested structured JSON messages for tool output chunks. suggested framing: newline-delimited JSON with a `type` field. example: ```{"type":"fncall_start","call_id":"abc123","name":"get_order"}```
kevin: ndjson is the right move. we'll include `event_type`, `seq`, and `more` boolean flags. backward compatibility plan: default behavior unchanged unless client sets `stream_events=true` on the request.
maria: action items: @kevin to draft internal RFC + perf baseline (5d), @chris to scope SDK changes and prototype parsers (7d), @ashley to confirm BetaCorp pilot NDA & timeline (ASAP), @olivia to capture commercial terms. i'll add this to the triage board and tag `customer-driven`. react with :eyes: if you see it.
olivia: :thumbsup: i'll ping them tonight and get NDA status.
chris: one more ask — telemetry/privacy: we need an option to suppress sending chunk payloads to telemetry for PII-sensitive customers.
kevin: we'll add `suppress_telemetry` flag to the stream options. also need an e2e fallback test for when a model variant doesn't support streaming events.
maria: perfect. unless there are objections i'll mark as M and schedule a refinement session tomorrow 10:00am PT.
ashley: no objections. thanks all.
deploy-bot: created issue #789 on the product board for "streaming fncall events - BetaCorp pilot" (assignee: maria).
